correctness.rationale: The degree-eight polynomial is separable precisely for a²≠4. The universal Hasse--Witt coefficient formula yields exactly the anti-diagonal entries u=5−a² and v=a(a²−3)(a²+1) in characteristic 11. Exact binomial expansion and standard-library checker establish these identities. The semilinear iterates have rank equal to the matrix rank because the two switched axes share coefficient u and the central axis has coefficient v. The disjoint simple roots prove all ranks and the determinant multiplicities; the a-number follows from the Cartier dual. No finite experiment substitutes for this argument.

value.rationale: This is the complete intersection of a natural automorphism-enhanced genus-three moduli pencil with the nonordinary Hasse locus, including nontransverse multiplicity two at precisely the deeper p-rank-one points. Exact seven-point support and degree-nine divisor provide an invariant description not supplied by global codimension results. The absence of p-rank zero and exact a-number stratification bound characteristic-eleven degenerations. It is a motivated natural complete classification, not arbitrary finite data.
